subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete sentence.
stimulus: There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. The National Memorial i. for man is born to be free. b. The most moving sight ii. the people’s respect for the martyrs. c. The memorial stands iii. is made of blood. d. The will of people prevails iv. the struggle and great sacrifices of the people. e. The Towers symbolize v. is the several graves of the martyred freedom fighters. vi. straight up. vii. highly complex tower.
guide_solution: (a + iii) : The National Memorial is made of blood. (b + v) : The most moving sight is the several graves of the martyred freedom fighters. (c + vi) : The memorial stands straight up. (d + i) : The will of people prevails for man is born to be free. (e + ii) : The Towers symbolize the people’s respect for the martyrs.
